overview: Premium DeFi liquidity pool analytics dashboard supporting Uniswap, PancakeSwap, Raydium, ICP, ICPswap, and KongSwap protocols. Features a Bloomberg Terminal-inspired dark theme with advanced analytics, real-time tracking, and cross-chain comparison. Now includes a dedicated Derivatives page with live funding rate trackers, open interest charts, and long/short ratio panels powered by real Binance public APIs.
features: Live funding rate tracker with Binance API integration
Open interest charts with historical trends
Long/short ratio panels with interactive time period selection
Pool comparison with watchlist and price alerts
Position tracker with ICPswap/KongSwap API integration
Impermanent loss calculator with ICP principal support
AI Assistant with decision history and performance tracker
Glassmorphism dark theme with glowing effects
